edition_drift_summary: N3 (per the 2018 CB forum community summary) used 5 labelled program families (SWORD/SHIELD/CLAW/GADGET/UPGRADE) across 7 device types (AHD/HD/HD+/KHD/DHD/WHD/EVO), including army-wide passive 'Army Shield' programs (EXORCISM, HACK-TRANSPORT AIRCRAFT, U-TURN) and reactive-only 'Defense Protocol' programs (BREAKWATER, ZERO PAIN, COUNTERSTRIKE). The current N5.2 wiki pages show only 4 device types (Hacking Device, Hacking Device Plus, Killer Hacking Device, EVO Hacking Device) and only 2 labelled program categories (Upgrade, Supportware); none of AHD/DHD/WHD/EXORCISM/U-TURN/HACK-TRANSPORT AIRCRAFT/BREAKWATER/COUNTERSTRIKE appear on the current Hacking Device or Hacking Programs Chart pages (confirmed absent by direct page read). This is presented in the vault note as an instructive finding, not just trivia.
